verdict.rationale: Mailgun documents Batch Sending: one API request can take multiple 'to' recipients, with Recipient Variables personalizing each message. That covers the core of sending a personalized batch without looping one call per recipient. Nothing in the pack shows the response returning a per-message status for each recipient, and the batch mention is a single FAQ line. Missing for 10: evidence of per-message status in the batch response, in-depth API reference for batch sending (limits, response shape), independent or hands-on corroboration.
